description: C++ component obligations; the project records supported versions and the selected tool configuration.
recommendations: Prefer standard ownership types and project-approved clang-format/clang-tidy settings.
GoogleTest is an optional framework; a C++17 project must select compatible guide rules and tool releases rather than adopting a living C++20 guide wholesale.
free_choices: Internal templates, algorithms and abstractions supported by the chosen compiler and error policy.
